request.system: You are an email structure reviewer. You are advisory and lenient.
request.user:
Assess structural quality only (subject length, a clear call to action, scannable body). This is advisory; be lenient and do not penalise legitimate creative variation.
Subject: A note from Northbay Supply
CTA: Visit Northbay Supply -> https://www.northbaysupply.com
Body: Hey,

It's been a while, and we noticed.

We're putting together a win-back offer for folks who've spent time with us before — but before anything goes out the door, a human on our team needs to confirm the discount terms, verify the expiration date, and make sure the right products are attached to this campaign.

We don't want to promise you a number we haven't locked down, or point you toward gear details that aren't ready. That's not how we operate.

Sit tight. Someone from Northbay will be in touch shortly with the full, confirmed offer. We appreciate your patience — and we're glad you're still out there.
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.

response: {"reasoning": "The email has a reasonable subject line (under 50 characters), a clear CTA link, and a body that is short and readable, though it notably lacks scannability aids like bullet points or headers and the CTA feels somewhat disconnected from a message that explicitly says the offer isn't ready yet — however, these are legitimate stylistic and contextual choices for a pre-offer holding email.", "evidence": ["Subject 'A note from Northbay Supply' is concise and within acceptable length", "CTA 'Visit Northbay Supply' is present and clearly linked", "Body is brief and conversational with natural paragraph breaks", "No bullet points or headers, but prose length is short enough to remain scannable", "CTA placement is slightly misaligned with message content (offer not yet confirmed), but this is a creative/contextual choice"], "score": 0.75, "verdict": "pass"}
